A [[humanoid]] '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. At the end of the conflict, the [[Jedi]] was stationed in [[Tipoca City]], the [[capital]] of [[Kamino]], the [[planet]] where the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]'s [[clone trooper]]s had been [[Cloning|created]]. When [[Order 66]], a secret command ordering the [[Death penalty|execution]] of all Jedi as [[Treason|traitors]], was issued by [[Darth Sidious]], they were among those [[Death|killed]]. Subsequently, the members of the irregular [[clone commando]] unit [[Clone Force 99]]—most of whom were immune to the command due to [[Genetically defective clone|genetic defects]] or [[cybernetics]]—saw the [[Jedi Master]]'s corpse being carried through [[landing bay one-tac-one]] by [[Coruscant Guard]] [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]] upon their return to Tipoca [[City]], witnessing the dead Jedi's [[lightsaber]] falling from their hand.

==Biography==
A [[Jedi Master]]<ref name="Pablo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1467612968506458115|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=@Grandmaster_Nic The Jedi Master was named in the script; it's a new character, but I'd rather someone more attached the show reveal that information. The other droids only have production names of Kaminoan training droid and Kaminoan medical droid.|archivedate=20211205230643}}</ref> served the [[Jedi Order]] during the final [[Standard year|years]] of the [[Republic Era]] and the [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Aftermath" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> near the war's end, the [[Jedi]] was stationed in [[Tipoca City]],<ref name="Aftermath" /> the [[capital]] of the [[extragalactic]] [[planet]] [[Kamino]], home to the [[Kaminoan]]s who had created the [[clone trooper]]s of the [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. Unbeknownst to the Jedi, who were aware the [[Cloning|clone]] [[army]] had been commissioned by the [[Death|deceased]] Jedi Master [[Sifo-Dyas]],<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> the clones' creation had been hijacked by the [[Sith]], their ancient enemy, who had the clones [[Behavioral modification biochip|engineered]] to [[Death penalty|execute]] them via the secret command [[Order 66]],<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> which also declared all Jedi to be [[Treason|traitors]]. When the command was given by [[Darth Sidious]]—publicly the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine—the Jedi Master was one of the many casualties, dying with their [[lightsaber]] in their [[Limb|hand]].<ref name="Aftermath" />

[[File:JediDropsLightsaber-Aftermath.png|thumb|left|250px|The Jedi's lightsaber falls from their hand]]
Shortly after the issuance of Order 66, [[Clone Force 99]]—an irregular [[clone commando]] unit nicknamed the "Bad Batch"—returned to Kamino from a [[Battle of Kaller|battle]] on [[Kaller]]. Four of the [[squad]]'s five members were immune to the Order 66 [[Brain|mind]] control due to either their status as [[genetically defective clone]]s or extensive [[Cybernetics|cybernetic]] implants, and they were thus deeply confused by the situation, having witnessed the murder of Jedi Master [[Depa Billaba]] at the hands of her own [[Depa Billaba's second battalion|troops]]. Landing their [[starship]], the [[Marauder (Omicron-class)|''Marauder'']], in [[landing bay one-tac-one]], the [[commando]]s were struck by the presence of [[Coruscant Guard]] [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]], before noticing two [[trooper]]s carrying the Jedi Master's cloth-draped corpse through the [[hangar]] on a stretcher. The Jedi's left hand, clutching their lightsaber, slipped out from underneath the shroud, and the [[weapon]] fell to the floor. A nearby [[Unidentified shock trooper quartermaster|shock trooper officer]] picked up the lightsaber, before pointedly asking [[Clone Sergeant]] [[Hunter]], the Batch's leader, if there was a problem due to the way he and his squad were staring. Hunter responded that there was no problem, and the [[officer]] stated that there would be a [[Proclamation of the New Order|mandatory briefing]] at 1500 before leaving, following the troopers carrying the body.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Personality and traits==
The Jedi Master was a [[humanoid]] with a feminine body shape. Their skin was [[Color|purple]] on the back of the hand and a greenish yellow on the palms, which had four fingers and a thumb.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Equipment==
The Jedi Master owned a lightsaber with a silver hilt and gold accents.<ref name="Aftermath" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Master appeared, unidentified, as a corpse in "[[Aftermath (episode)|Aftermath]]," the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]'',<ref name="Aftermath" /> which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2021]].<ref name="D23">{{D23|url=everything-new-you-can-stream-on-disney-in-may-2021|text=Everything New You Can Stream on Disney+ in May 2021|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]] later revealed that the Jedi Master was a new character who had been named in the episode's script, though Hidalgo did not say what the name was, stating he preferred to let someone closer to the show reveal the information.<ref name="Pablo" />
